name: Ya Man Kont Habiby
overview: In a dramatic atmosphere charged with excitement and suspense, and after a violent love story between (Tariq) and (Abeer), the days separate them, but fate brings them together in one house again, when (Abeer) marries (Mohammed), and (Tariq) marries (Muhammed's sister), fear begins to infiltrate both Grims, and many events occur when (Khalid) and (Hanan) discover the old love story between them.
